name: Albion Farmer s Market
tagline: Albion Farmer s Market in Albion, Michigan
description: Albion Farmer s Market gathers local farms and food producers in 211 Market Place, MI. The market is a hub for seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from nearby growers. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
